This page lists 69 Windsurf keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `windsurf.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Windsurf to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t windsurf.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/windsurf.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Windsurf.app`; if Windsurf lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## AI Autocomplete

Windsurf AI completion shortcuts.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇥` | Accept suggestion |
| `⎋` | Cancel suggestion |
| `⌘→` | Accept suggestion word-by-word |
| `⌥]` | Next suggestion |
| `⌥[` | Previous suggestion |
| `⌥\` | Trigger suggestion |

## General

Inherits most VS Code shortcuts.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘P` | Show Command Palette |
| `⌘P` | Quick Open, Go to File |
| `⇧⌘N` | New window |
| `⌘W` | Close window |
| `⌘,` | User Settings |
| `⌘K⌘S` | Keyboard Shortcuts |

## Basic Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘X` | Cut line (empty selection) |
| `⌘C` | Copy line (empty selection) |
| `⌥↓` | Move line down |
| `⌥↑` | Move line up |
| `⇧⌥↓` | Copy line down |
| `⇧⌥↑` | Copy line up |
| `⇧⌘K` | Delete line |
| `⌘⏎` | Insert line below |
| `⇧⌘⏎` | Insert line above |
| `⌘]` | Indent line |
| `⌘[` | Outdent line |
| `⌘/` | Toggle line comment |
| `⇧⌥A` | Toggle block comment |

## Multi-cursor & Selection

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥+click` | Insert cursor |
| `⌥⌘↑` | Insert cursor above |
| `⌥⌘↓` | Insert cursor below |
| `⌘U` | Undo last cursor operation |
| `⌘L` | Select current line |
| `⇧⌘L` | Select all occurrences of selection |
| `⌘D` | Add selection to next Find match |

## Search & Replace

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘F` | Find |
| `⌥⌘F` | Replace |
| `⌘G` | Find next |
| `⇧⌘G` | Find previous |
| `⇧⌘F` | Find in files |
| `⇧⌘H` | Replace in files |

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘T` | Show all Symbols |
| `⌃G` | Go to Line |
| `⌘P` | Go to File |
| `⇧⌘O` | Go to Symbol |
| `⇧⌘M` | Show Problems panel |
| `F8` | Go to next error/warning |
| `⇧F8` | Go to previous error/warning |
| `⌃-` | Go back |
| `⌃⇧-` | Go forward |

## Editor Management

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘W` | Close editor |
| `⌘\` | Split editor |
| `⌘1` | Focus 1st editor group |
| `⌘2` | Focus 2nd editor group |
| `⌘3` | Focus 3rd editor group |

## File Management

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New File |
| `⌘O` | Open File |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌥⌘S` | Save All |
| `⇧⌘T` | Reopen closed editor |

## Display

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃⌘F` | Toggle full screen |
| `⌘=` | Zoom in |
| `⇧⌘-` | Zoom out |
| `⌘B` | Toggle Sidebar visibility |
| `⇧⌘E` | Show Explorer |
| `⇧⌘F` | Show Search |
| `⌃⇧G` | Show Source Control |
| `⇧⌘D` | Show Debug |
| `⇧⌘X` | Show Extensions |

## Terminal

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `` ⌃` `` | Show integrated terminal |
| `` ⌃⇧` `` | Create new terminal |

## Template file

The full [`windsurf.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/windsurf.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
